opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a ‘Good’ rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support organisations working with disability. We award grants to capital projects which help people to live more independently. We are particularly interested in projects which focus on training, employment and supported housing, especially when the project helps young people transition from children’s services to adults’ services.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a ‘Good’ rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We provide funding for charities working in mental health. We award grants towards capital projects, with an emphasis on projects which focus on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a ‘Good’ rating from a regulator such as CQC. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support organisations which provide care and services for older people, particularly if they have a neurodegenerative condition or are isolated. We award grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support organisations managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance and that have a clear emphasis on public access and engagement. We award grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS. If applicable, should have at least a ‘Good’ rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Our funding for hospices and palliative care organisations supports places which provide excellent care to patients and their families. We award grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for places of worship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or a local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We provide capital funding to places of worship for new building, refurbishment or equipment projects that improve access and community engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections and which have a clear emphasis on public access and engagement. We usually award grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support museums and galleries with capital projects that improve public access, interpretation and conservation of collections of national significance.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We provide capital funding to performing arts organisations for new buildings, refurbishment or equipment that enhances public engagement with the arts.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We fund public engagement with science organisations for capital projects that improve access, facilities and outreach to the public.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support secondary schools and sixth form colleges with capital funding for new buildings, refurbishment or equipment that enhances learning environments.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools & colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We fund special schools and colleges for capital projects that improve facilities for students with special educational needs.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research‑intensive university or research institution undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We provide funding for research‑intensive universities and research institutions for new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high‑quality research.
